description: Return one funnel's conversion broken down by referrer, by funnelId from list_funnels. Paginated over referrers. Referrers with a single visitor are omitted, so totals can be lower than get_funnel_analytics.

cohort.description: Read-only cohort. Funnel filters select first-step visitors; subsequent ordered steps may have different context. Goal filters select page-view visitors and matching completions. Saved filters are ANDed. trait:<key> uses current resolved-user traits with equals/not_equals/in/not_in; requires authenticated website read. Use the referrer breakdown tool to compare source groups. These are visitors, not attempts.

from.description: Inclusive start of the measurement period; pair with to instead of preset.

limit.description: Number of items to return on this page.

offset.description: Items to skip. Use the previous offset plus limit for the next page.

preset.description: Date preset such as last_7d. Alternative to from/to; defaults to last_30d.

to.description: Inclusive end of the measurement period; pair with from instead of preset.

websiteDomain.description: Or its domain, such as example.com.

name: get_funnel_analytics_by_referrer

outputSchema.description: referrer_analytics contains referrer text, parsed name/type/domain, total_users, completed_users and conversion_rate percent per referrer. range is the measured period; requestedRange appears if adjusted. conversionWindowHours is the funnel completion window. total counts qualifying referrers; hasMore indicates another page; hint explains empty results. Single-visitor referrers are excluded.

title: Get funnel analytics by referrer
